title: Automations pillar: the rail groups flows by trigger object with a trigger-kind glyph and a status dot; the Enabled switch and the Trigger / Run as / version meta move into the item header; Variables / Runs / Problems / Debug become tabs
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1, 3 and 5. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91` at `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/automations`: a full-width band "Off by default · review before enabling [switch] Enabled" above the rail; the rail lists 23 flows flat, each wrapping to two lines with "On" / "Not running here" at the right; the canvas column opens with a "Visual orchestration · click a node to configure" chip beside the flow name, then an info bar (Trigger / Status / Run as / v plus Variables, Runs, Problems, Debug buttons) inside a bordered card, then the canvas; the Configuration aside is `w-72`.

The maintainer asked for the rail to group by object (ruling quoted on the epic). The grouping key was measured in the hotcrm source: a record-triggered flow's start node `config.objectName`; a scheduled flow's first data node object (`contract_renewal` → `crm_contract`, `opportunity_stagnation` → `crm_opportunity`, `forecast_snapshot` → `crm_forecast` by what it writes); a screen flow's launching action object (`campaign_enrollment` → `crm_campaign`, `schedule_followup` → `crm_lead`); an autolaunched subflow's first data node (`campaign_lead_member_enroll` → `crm_campaign_member`). The 23 flows group into Account 2, Campaign 2, Campaign Member 2, Contact 1, Contract 2, Forecast 1, Lead 4, Opportunity 7, Quote 1, Task 1.

## Target

1. **Rail** (shared rail card): group headers in the object order the Data rail uses (alphabetical by label), each with its count; rows carry a 14 px trigger-kind glyph (bolt = record-triggered, clock = scheduled, pointer = screen, corner-arrow = autolaunched subflow), the truncating flow label, and a 6 px status dot (green = on, gray = not running here) whose title holds the status words. A legend row at the rail's foot explains the four glyphs and two dots. Grouping is computed client-side from the flow's own definition as served (start node object; first data node; the action that references the flow); a flow with no object lands in a trailing "No object" group. Search filters within groups.
2. **Item header row**: a primary-soft tile with the automations glyph, the flow label at 18 px / 600, the api name as a mono chip, then "Trigger · screen", "Run as · user", "v1" as 12 px muted meta separated by dots; at the right the Enabled switch (36 by 20 px, green when on) with its label, whose title carries "Off by default · review before enabling", a divider, a more button. The full-width band retires.
3. **Tab row**: Canvas, Variables, Runs, Problems (with an amber count pill when problems exist), Debug — underline tabs replacing the info-bar buttons; the Variables, Runs and Problems panels open as the tab's body (or as today's sheets, if their content cannot host inline; the card author decides and says which in the PR).
4. **Canvas**: dotted-grid sidebar-tinted background; node cards 260 px wide, 8 px radius, a 28 px kind-colored tile (start green, screen pink, get-record blue, decision amber, loop violet, end gray), the label at 13 px / 600, the kind at 10 px uppercase with the object api name in mono; the selected node has the primary border and ring; a floating zoom control (−, percentage, +, fit) at the bottom right. Node layout and edges are the existing engine's; only the card styling changes.
5. **Configuration aside** per the shared inspector card: eyebrow "Node · Decision", the node label, close; a decision node shows each outcome as a card with the target node name and its CEL condition in a mono textarea; "Add outcome" as a dashed button.

The flow-status truth (`flowStatusTruth-11779`), the enable toggle's refusal paths (`authorRefusal-11785`, `heldIncomplete-11786`), the canvas chip ruling (`flowCanvasChip-11665`: no literal `flow` token in the zh header; the api name on hover) and the narrow-row fold (`narrowRow-11795`) are all kept.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`AutomationsPillar`: band, rail, canvas header, info bar, aside), `FlowStatusDot`, a small `flowGrouping.ts` for the object key with a unit test, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (group labels reuse object labels; new keys for the legend and the "No object" group).

## Acceptance

1. With HotCRM open the rail shows the ten groups and counts listed above, pinned by a unit test over the served flow definitions.
2. The band is gone; the switch is in the item header and still toggles `status` with the same confirmation and refusal paths.
3. Problems count shows as a pill on the tab; the four former info-bar buttons have no duplicate elsewhere.
4. `AutomationsPillar.*`, `FlowStatusDot.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665`, `flowPresets-11861`, `newFlowTrigger-11788`, `packageLessFlows-11553` stay green or are updated in the same PR, each ablated once.
5. Before/after screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`.
- Lands after the shared rail and inspector cards (the Blocked-by lines below).

## Reference artboard

`docs/design/studio-redesign/automations.html` on objectui main (landed in objectstack-ai/objectui#12458); `automations.png` is its 1280 px render. The folder's README carries the shared numbers and what a pull request against this card must show: two screenshots per artboard it touches (light and dark, 1280 px, cropped to the artboard's region), a deviation list with a reason per line, and the card's named tests green or updated. Where this card and the artboard disagree, this card's numbers win and the disagreement is reported here.

Blocked-by: #12459
